name: AnimeClick Metadata
description: Provider metadati anime in italiano basato su AnimeClick.it con scraping etico e cache locale.
overview: Fornisce titoli, trame, generi, valutazioni e cover art in italiano per anime, utilizzando AnimeClick.it come fonte.

versions.changelog: v0.2.0: Matching episodi universale con normalizzazione AnimeClick per numero assoluto, progressivo stagione e ID episodio. Diagnostica admin per lookup, preview episodi e pulizia cache mirata. Ricerca migliorata con scoring per titolo, anno e tipo. Cache episodi/season-map versionata. OP/ED best-effort con warning per pagine trailer/PV-only.
v0.1.2: Fix metadati multi-stagione. Parsing S{N} Ep.{M} per stagioni sulla stessa pagina. Risoluzione stagioni su pagine separate via relazioni AnimeClick. Nuovo SeasonProvider. Filtro spin-off.

name: KometaThemes
description: KometaThemes automatically downloads anime theme songs (OPs and EDs) from animethemes.moe. Features multi-season detection, AllPerSeason fetch, multi-provider resolution, parallel downloads, global playlist generation, REST API, and bilingual Italian/English UI.
overview: Download anime OP/ED from animethemes.moe with multi-provider, multi-season, and playlist support.

versions.changelog: v2.5.1: injector v4 — button recreated on every hash change. Fixes disappearing button and stale item IDs between detail pages.
v2.5.0: MutationObserver injector (stable button). Info card with synopsis. Clean title + year filter. Loading spinner. Alt search. Error messages.
v2.3.2: Fix search undefined. Info card with item details. Clean title pre-fill. Year filter. Loading spinner. Alt search buttons. Synopsis display. Better errors.
v2.3.1: Fix search 422 (remove include from search). Fix anime by ID endpoint (/anime/?filter[id]=xxx).
v2.3.0: Theme Finder — manual OP/ED search & download. Music note button on detail pages. Select audio/video per theme. Select All / Download Selected. Already-downloaded detection.
v2.2.0: Hardcoded Anime-only (no lib regex). Live sync progress bar. DegreeOfParallelism slider. Item page in menu. Compiled regex. GUID normalize. Item button JS endpoint.

v2.1.0: Anime-only libraries. Fixes: DownloadTracker race, ffmpeg orphans, ForceSync restore, SemaphoreSlim leak, timer swallows, regex crash, API batch pagination, itemPage delete. New: SyncStatusTracker live progress, SeasonDetectionMode wired, MaxThemesPerSeason enforced, AniListClient registered, CDN resilience.

v2.0.3: Fix ArgumentNullException on virtual items (null ContainingFolderPath). Fix title search crash (clean codec tags, handle 422). Force Sync button uses task GUID. IsSatisfied uses MovieSettings.

v2.0.2: Fix title search crash (clean codec tags, handle 422). Force Sync button uses task GUID (fixes 404). IsSatisfied uses MovieSettings. SkippedItems filtered. AllPerSeason removed from movie selects.

v2.0.1: Fix Force Sync 404 on Jellyfin 10.11.x (use task GUID lookup). IsSatisfied uses MovieSettings. SkippedItems filtered. AllPerSeason removed from movie selects. ForceSync button prominent + truly forces.

v2.0.0: Multi-season/AllPerSeason, AniList, Skip/Ignore, per-item Sync API, M3U playlist. Hotfix: IsSatisfied now uses MovieSettings for movies, SkippedItems filtered in resolver, AllPerSeason removed from movie selects, ForceSync button truly forces.
v1.1.2: Fixed mapping save error, search scope bug, injector loads from GitHub raw.
